review:
The 2021 hit rebuilt on 6x6 Megaways, with up to 236,196 ways – the extra height makes wins look very different from the 10-line original.

Two bonuses: free spins where collectors grab instant wins and every four retrigger and raise the multiplier, and a Hold&Spin with three respins that reset on every new prize. Both feed the 20,000x max, one of the highest in the family. 96.7% RTP. Swingier than the original.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
